title: Spaghetti & Meatballs (The Vivaldi Way)
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef + 1/2 lb ground pork (or Italian sausage)
1/2 cup Italian breadcrumbs soaked in 1/3 cup whole milk (panade)
1/2 cup freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano + Pecorino Romano
3 cloves garlic, minced & 2 tbsp fresh Italian parsley, chopped
1 tsp kosher salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp dried oregano
1 lb spaghetti + 4 cups San Marzano tomato marinara sauce + fresh basil
instructions: Soak the breadcrumbs in milk for 5 minutes, then gently mix with the ground beef, ground pork, Parmigiano, eggs, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper without overworking.
Roll into 2-oz meatballs and sear in olive oil in a Dutch oven (or roast at 425°F for 12 minutes) until browned on the outside.
Transfer the seared meatballs directly into simmering San Marzano tomato sauce and braise gently for 20–25 minutes so they stay impossibly tender.
Toss al dente spaghetti with the rich tomato sauce, a splash of starchy pasta water, and grated Parmigiano, then crown with meatballs and fresh basil.
